entry.title: New: dsh-recall
entry.summary: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread. Exact install spec: dsh-recall. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
